## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit test, or a journey for editor / sync / encryption changes)
- [ ] CI passes locally: `cargo test --workspace`, and from `crates/minotes-app`: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm test`, `npx vite build`
- [ ] A line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md` if users will notice the change
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording for any UI change
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/guide/` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`) if behaviour or setup changed
